title: The Box from Grandma
can_do: 面对没见过的新东西，主动问“里面是什么、谁寄的”等细节问题。

conversation_move.label: ask detail questions about something new

trigger: A delivery box arrives and Mom does not know what is inside, so Child's questions are the way to find out.
setting: A package delivery moment at the entry counter.
essential_props: one delivery box with a small card and green winter gloves

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: A big box came for us today.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: I don't know yet. It's from Grandma.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: From Grandma? What did she send?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Open it with me and find out.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: What does the little card say?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: It says, "A surprise for brave helpers."

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: A surprise for helpers! Is it for me?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I love them! What can I help with first?

replay_cards.title: The neighbor's new car
replay_cards.setting: A shiny car stops in front of the house.
replay_cards.change: Dad only says it belongs to someone on the street.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks whose car it is and what the blue badge means, and learns it is the neighbor's new blue car.

replay_cards.title: A package for Max
replay_cards.setting: A package arrives at Max's house while Child is visiting.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks what is inside and who sent it, then helps open it and finds a kite for windy days.

parent_support: 收快递时把“打开前猜一猜”的环节留给孩子，用他的提问推动揭晓。
孩子问出一个细节就回答一个，保持你一句我一句的节奏。
揭晓后让孩子复述一句“这是谁寄的、用来做什么”，巩固信息。
